It cannot. Yii message isn't running application code so it has no idea about what's in `$detail->name`.

Hmm, I dont think so. https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/console/controllers/MessageController.php#L264
There will match the $category and $message parameter and execute the $message with eval function.

In Yii 1 it works, as far I know.
In 1.1 it doesn't work as well. `eval` there is to get rid of PHP string escaping. Yes, it runs the code but only code that's in the argument. It has no idea about the context, controller etc.
@yiisoft/core-developers btw., is there a good way to deal with escaping w/o using eval?
message command can not extract messages from this but it should not fail with exception but ignore the case.
But the developer should get a notification about it, that he can fix it if he want.

I have found one more thing, when I change the language in app config to 'en', than I get think error in my log:

```
The message file for category 'yii' does not exist: /Users/bk/projects/climdb/vendor/yiisoft/yii2/messages/en/yii.php
```

Of course the messages are already in english, but this should'nt be an error.
That means you have application source language that is not `en` while target language is `en` or you're forcing translation.
